scenes.headline: How Inkling is built to be adapted
scenes.sub: An open-weights mixture of experts: text, image and audio in one stack.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Waffles! Inkling is an open-weights model whose makers say plainly it's not the strongest. It's built to be adapted. Here's how.

scenes.text: One sparse stack reads text, images and audio directly, and a caller-set effort knob decides how many tokens each answer spends.
scenes.say: One sparse stack reads text, images and audio directly. And a knob the caller sets decides how many tokens each answer spends.

scenes.title: Sixty-six layers, two kinds of sparsity

steps.say: Inkling has sixty-six layers. In each one, a token passes through attention, then a mixture of experts.
Fifty-five layers attend only within a five-hundred-twelve-token window. Eleven are global. Five cheap layers for every exact one.

steps.note: 41B of 975B parameters work on each token
steps.say: A sigmoid router picks six of two hundred fifty-six experts, and two shared experts are always on. Only forty-one billion parameters work per token.
There's no separate vision or audio encoder. Every modality becomes tokens.
Images are cut into forty by forty pixel patches, lifted by a small four-layer MLP.
Audio becomes discrete dMel spectrogram tokens.
All of it shares one hidden space and the same experts, so fine-tuning touches one stack.

scenes.label: of the tokens, for Nemotron 3 Ultra's accuracy on Terminal-Bench 2.1
scenes.note: vendor-reported, on Thinking Machines' own evals
scenes.say: The effort knob is the system message plus a per-token cost. On Terminal-Bench, the lab reports Nemotron's accuracy at about a third of the tokens.

items.say: Pretraining covered forty-five trillion tokens of text, image, audio and video.
Then asynchronous reinforcement learning, over thirty million rollouts.
Held-out reward rose in a straight line on a log scale.
And with no brevity reward, the chain of thought got shorter by itself.

scenes.text: Inkling is a base, not a trophy: one sparse multimodal stack, and a knob that lets the caller own the cost.
scenes.mark: lets the caller own the cost
scenes.say: So Inkling is a base, not a trophy: one sparse stack for every modality, and a knob so the caller owns the cost.

recap: No encoders: images and audio become tokens
An effort knob trades tokens for accuracy
scenes.say: To recap: a sparse hybrid stack, no separate encoders, and a knob for effort.
